courier-relay/current-protocol: Courier Relay: current protocol is 2 (approved 2026-09-07 by integration owner csells, per trial-13n). Protocol 2 identifies a delivery by the pair (account_id, delivery_id) instead of protocol 1's delivery_id-alone identity; tie-break on duplicates is still latest occurred_at UTC instant then smallest record_id (note: this is the opposite tie-break direction from protocol 1, which keeps the EARLIEST occurred_at, per vendor/protocol-1.md). Protocol 1 remains supported (SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS in main.py) for requests that explicitly set "protocol":"1"; only the default (omitted-protocol) selection changed from "1" to "2". count and summary both return exactly {protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count} for either protocol; only the identity-grouping key differs by protocol. Full protocol 2 text is documented in vendor/protocol-2.md (mirroring vendor/protocol-1.md's role for protocol 1). Source: trial-13n issue description.
